title: Mula office hanggang site.
label: SAMPLE DATA
narration: Ito ang DAC’S Web, ang workspace ng office para sa projects, records, billing, at coordination. Tingnan natin ang major modules, pati ang planned connection sa WorkMate.
spokenText: Ito ang Daks Web, ang workspace ng office para sa projects, records, billing, at coordination. Tingnan natin ang major modules, pati ang planned connection sa WorkMate.
direction: Logo → desktop; main navigation reveals.

title: Tamang access sa bawat role.
label: SAMPLE DATA
narration: Sa Users at access settings, nakaayon sa role at allowed modules ang makikita ng bawat account. Owner-only information ay may sariling restrictions.
spokenText: Sa Users at access settings, nakaayon sa role at allowed modules ang makikita ng bawat account. Owner-only information ay may sariling restrictions.

title: Bawat project, malinaw ang picture.
label: SAMPLE DATA
narration: Sa Project Control, magkakasama ang project overview, billing periods, additional works, at cost details. Mula sa summary, puwedeng mag-drill down para makita kung saan nanggagaling ang figures.
spokenText: Sa Project Control, magkakasama ang project overview, billing periods, additional works, at cost details. Mula sa summary, puwedeng mag-drill down para makita kung saan nanggagaling ang figures.
direction: Owner Project Control: folder grid → project detail; main/AW.

title: Tatlong cost buckets. Isang total.
label: SAMPLE DATA
narration: Hiwalay ang Labor, Material, at Overhead para malinaw ang gastos. Ang billing allocations naman ay planning guide; hindi ito automatic na dagdag sa revenue, cost, o profit.
spokenText: Hiwalay ang Labor, Material, at Overhead para malinaw ang gastos. Ang billing allocations naman ay planning guide; hindi ito automatic na dagdag sa revenue, cost, o profit.
direction: Owner cost breakdown: Labor/Material/Overhead; allocation plan separate.

title: Traceable ang bawat expense.
label: SAMPLE DATA
narration: Sa expense at labor records, makikita ang supporting details at pakyaw contracts. Kasama na sa total cost ang Cover expenses; hindi ito idinadagdag ulit bilang panibagong bucket.
spokenText: Sa expense at labor records, makikita ang supporting details at pakyaw contracts. Kasama na sa total cost ang Cover expenses; hindi ito idinadagdag ulit bilang panibagong bucket.

title: Progress ang basehan.
label: SAMPLE DATA
narration: Sa Accomplishment, binabalikan ang progress ng bawat BOQ item. Dito nakabatay ang earned revenue. Kapag wala pang accomplishment data, malinaw ang Forecast label sa kaukulang estimate.
spokenText: Sa Accomplishment, binabalikan ang progress ng bawat B O Q item. Dito nakabatay ang earned revenue. Kapag wala pang accomplishment data, malinaw ang Forecast label sa kaukulang estimate.
direction: BOQ line progress → accomplishment → Earned; Forecast clearly labelled.

title: Mula billing hanggang payment.
label: SAMPLE DATA
narration: Para sa billing, nandito ang invoices, labor invoices, at payment requests. Puwedeng i-review ang records at gamitin ang available print, PDF, o CSV outputs ng module.
spokenText: Para sa billing, nandito ang invoices, labor invoices, at payment requests. Puwedeng i-review ang records at gamitin ang available print, PDF, o CSV outputs ng module.

title: Hiwalay ang tamang records.
label: SAMPLE DATA
narration: May hiwalay na company overhead at owner-only reimbursement tracker. Ang reimbursement status ay tracking record; hindi ito automatic na bagong invoice, payment, o project expense.
spokenText: May hiwalay na company overhead at owner-only reimbursement tracker. Ang reimbursement status ay tracking record; hindi ito automatic na bagong invoice, payment, o project expense.

title: Project Management. Sariling workflow.
label: SAMPLE DATA
narration: Sa Project Management, may sariling projects, daily expense records, weekly billing, procurement, at milestones. Hiwalay ito sa Project Control, kaya hindi dapat paghaluin ang kanilang project records.
spokenText: Sa Project Management, may sariling projects, daily expense records, weekly billing, procurement, at milestones. Hiwalay ito sa Project Control, kaya hindi dapat paghaluin ang kanilang project records.

title: Site updates na nababalikan.
label: SAMPLE DATA
narration: Para sa site operations, may daily logs, walkthroughs, accomplishment reports, at revolving fund records. Tinutulungan nitong balikan ang updates at supporting details ng isang project.
spokenText: Para sa site operations, may daily logs, walkthroughs, accomplishment reports, at revolving fund records. Tinutulungan nitong balikan ang updates at supporting details ng isang project.

title: Maayos hanggang closeout.
label: SAMPLE DATA
narration: Sa Project Closeout, malinaw kung completed o terminated ang project. May hiwalay ding Warranty Fund register para sa internal company reserve; hindi ito deduction sa client billing.
spokenText: Sa Project Closeout, malinaw kung completed o terminated ang project. May hiwalay ding Warranty Fund register para sa internal company reserve; hindi ito deduction sa client billing.
direction: Owner closeout: Completed/Terminated, final bill; warranty reserve register.

title: Proposal muna. Project kapag ready.
label: SAMPLE DATA
narration: Sa Quotations, gumawa ng itemized proposal, revisions, at status tracking. Ang Won na quotation ay hindi automatic na project o revenue; hiwalay pa rin ang admin action.
spokenText: Sa Quotations, gumawa ng itemized proposal, revisions, at status tracking. Ang Won na quotation ay hindi automatic na project o revenue; hiwalay pa rin ang admin action.

title: Kita ang araw sa site.
label: SAMPLE DATA

spokenText: Sa Attendance, tingnan kung sino ang nasa site, i-review ang Time In at Time Out records, at pamahalaan ang workers at sites. May hours reports at owner controls para sa app updates.

title: Organized ang requests at receipts.

title: WorkMate, connected sa office.
label: PLANNED MODULE
narration: Para sa planned WorkMate workflow, dito rerepasuhin ng office ang requests, catalogue matching, teams, at schedules. Kasama sa later stages ang item history, tool register, at owner-reviewed cost assignments, na malinaw ang pagkakaiba ng stock movement at project cost.
spokenText: Para sa planned WorkMate workflow, dito rerepasuhin ng office ang requests, catalogue matching, teams, at schedules. Kasama sa later stages ang item history, tool register, at owner-reviewed cost assignments, na malinaw ang pagkakaiba ng stock movement at project cost.
direction: Explicit PLANNED WORKMATE chapter; request queue → matching → schedule → owner cost review.

title: Mula meeting notes sa malinaw na tasks.
label: DESIGN PREVIEW
narration: Sa Meetings at Work Plan preview, puwedeng gawing draft tasks ang notes. Staff pa rin ang magre-review at magpa-publish. Makikita ang acknowledgements, blockers, at work na naghihintay ng final verification.
spokenText: Sa Meetings at Work Plan preview, puwedeng gawing draft tasks ang notes. Staff pa rin ang magre-review at magpa-publish. Makikita ang acknowledgements, blockers, at work na naghihintay ng final verification.
